reason: Corrects the atmospheric screen's pixel spacing. The builder re-derived it as D/pupil_pixels, but the calibration grid is a linspace spanning the full diameter, so its spacing is D/(pupil_pixels-1). The screen was therefore sampled 1.96 percent too finely, biasing D/r0 by about 3 percent in variance. The spacing is now read off calibration.x_m. Open-loop OPD RMS moves 636.86 -> 645.44 nm and H-band Strehl 0.5401 -> 0.5333 for all_effects. Supersedes the 2026-08-20 acceptance, which is withdrawn as physically incorrect.
review_reference: Code review of public-clean-main, finding P1 'physical phase screen uses the wrong pixel spacing' (error_budget.py:702); guarded by tests/experiments/test_physical_error_budget.py::test_the_atmospheric_screen_samples_the_calibration_grid.
